label: Backend / API Development
description: Server-side services, API handlers, request processing, authentication flows, service-layer business logic, and integration code that primarily lives behind an application boundary.

label: Frontend / UI Engineering
description: Browser, desktop, or rich-client user interface code focused on rendering, client-side state, input handling, accessibility, and presentation logic.

label: Mobile Development
description: Android, iOS, or cross-platform mobile code involving mobile application lifecycle, device capabilities, mobile UI, or platform SDK integration.

label: Database / Persistence
description: SQL query construction, ORM usage, transactions, schema access, data storage logic, caching layers, and other code centered on persistence or database interaction.

label: Data Engineering / Analytics
description: ETL pipelines, batch jobs, data transformation, streaming data processing, warehouse interaction, analytics computation, and reporting-oriented code.

label: Machine Learning / AI
description: Model training, inference, feature processing, evaluation pipelines, vector workflows, agent systems, or model-serving code built around ML or AI functionality.

label: Security / Application Security
description: Security controls, authentication and authorization enforcement, cryptographic operations, secure messaging, policy evaluation, vulnerability detection, or other code where security expertise is central to the implementation itself.

label: Cloud / DevOps / Platform Engineering
description: Deployment systems, containers, infrastructure provisioning, CI/CD, observability, service orchestration, platform automation, and cloud operations code.

label: Systems / Kernel / Low-Level Programming
description: Operating system internals, runtime systems, filesystems, low-level memory management, drivers, systems libraries, or performance-critical low-level code.

label: Embedded / IoT / Firmware
description: Microcontroller, firmware, RTOS, device-control, sensor, actuator, or hardware-adjacent code written for embedded or IoT environments.

label: Networking / Distributed Systems
description: Socket handling, transport protocols, network daemons, RPC frameworks, service coordination, distributed state, or concurrency patterns centered on networked systems.

label: Desktop / Enterprise Applications
description: Desktop software, internal enterprise applications, thick-client business workflows, or application logic tied to traditional workstation or enterprise environments.

label: Game / Graphics
description: Rendering, shaders, simulation, asset pipelines, game-engine logic, or other graphics-heavy or game-development code.

label: Blockchain / Web3
description: Smart contracts, wallets, token logic, blockchain nodes, consensus-related code, or application code built around distributed ledger systems.

label: Developer Tooling / Build Systems
description: Compilers, interpreters, linters, code generators, package managers, IDE integrations, test harnesses, or build and release tooling.

label: General Software Utility
description: Generic helpers, parsers, string or collection utilities, standalone algorithms, and shared support code where the project, path, and sample do not support a more specific expertise area.
